title: lint: pin delete_package as an accepted platform tool name in validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts, with a near-name control (should-fix from #31037)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(c) should-fix carried from a contract review** (#31037, review 6693733275, PASS).

## 维护者速读

#31037 往平台工具名单里加了 `delete_package`，但没有像以往每次加名字那样，在 lint 测试里补一条「这个名字被认可」的固定用例。功能上不受影响，只是少了一道防回退的测试。

## Expected

- In `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts`, pin that `delete_package` is accepted, with a near-name control that is flagged (e.g. `delete_packages`). This follows #16512, #27002 and eca7cd2008.

## Acceptance

- The pin fails if `delete_package` leaves the registry.

Serial: after #31037 merges.

Suggested-grade: p2 · XS.
